cruxes.question: Public B after a short gate, or a separate closed beta first?

sides.position: B after 1-2 weeks of real reports

cruxes.question: Monthly subscription or a paid one-off decision report?
Keep 13 councils or cut to three?

sides.position: Keep, they are surface not cost

note: Everyone gates the launch on working production and real reports; they fight over how long the gate is, how to price an occasional decision, and how many councils to show.
